tools.name: ghost_get_site
tools.description: Get the site title, URL, Ghost version and settings. Use it first to confirm which site is connected. Ghost Admin API: GET /site/.

tools.name: ghost_list_posts
tools.description: List posts with their status, title, slug, authors and tags. Filter by status with filter, for example "status:draft" or "status:published". Ghost Admin API: GET /posts/.

tools.name: ghost_get_post
tools.description: Get one post by id, including its body and updated_at. Keep updated_at: ghost_update_post needs it. Ghost Admin API: GET /posts/{id}/.

tools.name: ghost_list_pages
tools.description: List static pages with their status, title and slug. Ghost Admin API: GET /pages/.

tools.name: ghost_list_tags
tools.description: List post tags with their name, slug and post count. Ghost Admin API: GET /tags/.

tools.name: ghost_list_members
tools.description: List members (subscribers). Filter with NQL, for example "status:free" (free), "status:-free" (paid), or "subscribed:true". Search by name or email with search. Ghost Admin API: GET /members/.

tools.name: ghost_get_member
tools.description: Get one member by id: status, email, labels, subscriptions and the last seen time. Ghost Admin API: GET /members/{id}/.

tools.name: ghost_list_tiers
tools.description: List paid membership tiers with their name, status, and optional prices and benefits. Set include to monthly_price,yearly_price,benefits for prices. Ghost Admin API: GET /tiers/.

tools.name: ghost_list_newsletters
tools.description: List newsletters with their name, status and sender settings. Ghost Admin API: GET /newsletters/.

tools.name: ghost_list_offers
tools.description: List member offers (discounts or trials for paid tiers) with their code, status and redemption type. Ghost Admin API: GET /offers/.

tools.name: ghost_list_labels
tools.description: List member labels, the segments you use to group members. Ghost Admin API: GET /labels/.

tools.name: ghost_list_users
tools.description: List staff users (authors and admins) with their role, slug and status. Ghost Admin API: GET /users/.

tools.name: ghost_create_draft_post
tools.description: Create a new post as a DRAFT from HTML. It never publishes and never sends email; publish it in Ghost Admin. Ghost Admin API: POST /posts/?source=html.

tools.name: ghost_update_post
tools.description: Change a post's title, HTML, excerpt or tags. Pass updated_at from ghost_get_post (Ghost rejects a stale update). It does not change the status and never sends email. An already published post shows the new text at once. Ghost Admin API: PUT /posts/{id}/?source=html.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ghost_get_site, ghost_list_posts, ghost_get_post, ghost_list_tags, ghost_list_members, ghost_get_member · Public sink: ghost_get_post, ghost_list_tags, ghost_list_members, ghost_get_member, ghost_create_draft_post, ghost_update_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ghost_get_site, ghost_list_posts, ghost_get_post, ghost_list_tags, ghost_list_members, ghost_get_member · Public sink: ghost_get_post, ghost_list_tags, ghost_list_members, ghost_get_member, ghost_create_draft_post, ghost_update_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
